Under Commercial incentives and Uncertainty, disclose that Exo Mtn Gear produces the podcast, that the host received the Argali piece from its representative, and that he denies sponsorship, affiliate commissions, or kickbacks; treat results as one practitioner's observations and account for raft-supported extra gear when translating them to Mammoth.
